scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: Candidate 02 is the only candidate passing all hard gates, and mask-only review shows coherent moderate tumor-boundary expansion with nearly source-matched instance count, spacing and local clustering.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 36,725-pixel tumor expansion follows multiple authorized external tumor-stroma interfaces and preserves the intervening stroma, immune and non-target structures.
decisions.nucleus_layout: Thirty-nine class-1 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative instance-count, NND and Ripley K24 ratios are 0.995, 0.991 and 1.057, respectively.
decisions.coupling: Added tumor nuclei occupy the authorized expanded tumor footprints; boundary binding, seam continuity, quota, compatibility, spatial-distribution and local-density checks pass, with sampling score 0.896.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and native structures outside joint support remain unchanged, without partial-instance, overlap, border or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: The tissue area is only slightly above the frozen moderate floor and the joint-area gate relies on its predeclared accepted interval. This patient is not four-target eligible because U1 Significant abstained. Mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality or clinical validity.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 02 as the single mask-condition handoff for this target only.
